caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate glass goblet positioned centrally on a plain, light brown background. The goblet features a broad, slightly flared rim and a decorative upper section adorned with etched horizontal bands consisting of geometric patterns, lines, and star-like motifs. Below these bands, there are repeating garland-like swags that connect to circular flower or star designs. The midsection of the goblet transitions into a bulbous lower bowl that is divided into vertical, rounded segments or panels. The stem of the goblet is relatively short with a small, rounded knob separating the bowl from the wide, flat circular base, which is shaded to indicate clear material and dimensionality. The goblet is depicted in grayscale pencil or ink, with shading to give the illusion of transparency, highlights, and reflective surfaces. The drawing is rendered on paper with visible signs of age, such as discoloration near the edges, and includes the name “JOHN DANA” written in small capitals near the bottom right.
title: Vase
